rules.name: Avanti Savoia!
rules.description: At the beginning of each turn, subtract the number of units lost by the Italian Army from the number of units lost by the enemy if the number is 3+ all friendly Italian units gain +2 morale. If the number is -3 all friendly Italian units have their basic morale reduced by 2.

rules.name: Defensive Strategy
rules.description:
In Attacker-Defender scenarios if the Italian side does not win the Attacker versus Defender die roll make the roll again and the second roll stands. If the Italian player is the Defender:
•	During the first turn of the game the Attacker units may not Run as they are probing for mines.
•	The Italian artillery is already ranged: the player can reroll the die on the Artillery Barrage or Smoke Barrage charts.
•	During setup any Italian unit starting as Hidden may already be in  Ambush (place an order die).
•	Before deploying any units roll a d3: the result is the number of emplacements available (3-sided 6”x6” hard cover emplacements). They must be placed within 12” of the Italian player’s friendly table edge.

rules.name: Behind Enemy Lines
rules.description: The Arditi X would use infiltration tactics to strike at the enemy’s vulnerable rear lines. All units in this army ignore the -1 modifier to orders tests when outflanking.

rules.name: Hit and Run
rules.description: The Arditi trained to conduct raids after dark, striking at speed and relying on the element of surprise to get in and out, causing maximum damage for minimum losses. Any vehicle in this list that is currently assigned an Advance order may react to enemy shooting or assaulting by executing a single 9” move with one 90-degree turn if it passes a special morale test. If the test is failed, the opposing player gets to choose what happens: either the driver loses control and the opposing player may move the vehicle instead, or the vehicle stalls, remains stationary, and takes a pin. Either way, its dice is then changed to Down.

rules.name: Must be Mobile
rules.description: Arditi X infantry, headquarters, and artillery units must be provided with transport.

rules.name: Out of the Blue
rules.description: Any vehicles that are outflanking may enter on their designated board edge one turn earlier than normally permitted (i.e. from up to 24” on Turn 2, 36” on Turn 3, etc.).

rules.name: Sgonfiare le Gomme!
rules.description: Techniques mastered by the Sahariana allowed their experienced drivers to negotiate extremely difficult terrain in their hardy wheeled vehicles. All vehicles in this army may Advance through rough ground designated as sandy or rocky at a rate of 6”, with a single 90-degree turn.

rules.name: Blackshirts
rules.description: One unit of Blackshirts can replace the Non Testati special Rule with Fanatics special rule for +3pts per man.

rules.name: Vegance
rules.description: All regular and veteran units receive one free order test whenever enemy units are within 12”. For this test roll 1D6. On a roll of 4+ a pin is removed. Then roll for a regular order test to see if the unit can act. Roll even if the unit no longer has any pins; just use the standard morale.

rules.name: Avanti!
rules.description: Italian infantry units may reroll failed orders tests to Advance or Run if the Italian player is currently winning the game (use the victory points accrued by both sides already when a unit takes the orders test for the purposes of this rule).

rules.name: Anvanzare!
rules.description: Italian anti-tank guns may forward deploy as per snipers and forward observers (see Bolt Action rulebook page 131) in any mission (even those that prohibit forward deployment) and does not count towards totals for determining first waves, if they do.

rules.name: Poor Officers
rules.description: Italian officers may only add their command value to Ambush, Fire, and Rally order tests.

rules.name: Forza d'Animo
rules.description: All Italian artillery, self-propelled artillery, and Folgore Paracadutisti and X Reggimento Arditi infantry units remove D2 pins whenever they pass an orders test in place of the usual one pin removed.

rules.name: Testardo
rules.description: Italian infantry units have the stubborn special rule.

rules.name: Iron hulls, Iron hearts
rules.description: An Italian medium or light tank with the ‘Iron hulls, iron hearts’ rule may reroll any failed order tests to Advance or Run as long as this would bring them closer to an enemy unit.

rules.name: Defeat after Defeat, Followed by Impending Defeat
rules.description: At the beginning of each turn, subtract the number of units lost by the Italian Army from the number of units lost by the enemy. If the number is -3 all friendly Italian units have their basic morale reduced by 1.

rules.name: Improvvised AT
rules.description: When rolling to penetrate enemy vehicle using AT grenades or weapon with less than +3 penetration, the player may elect to re-roll the result.

rules.name: Large Squads
rules.description: Italian infantry units that have 14 or more men remaining cause D2 pins instead of one pin when performing a shooting attack against an enemy unit. italian squads lose this ability when they have 13 or fewer models remaining in their squad.

rules.name: Credere, Obbedire Combatere
rules.description:
Select one of the following bonuses to add to your army:
•	Credere: Blackshirts 'M' Battalion squad and regular HQ units gain the fanatics special rule.
•	Obbedire: Alpini squads gain the stubborn special rule. Veteran HQ units modeled as Alpini gain the Stubborn and mountaineers special rule.
•	Combattere: Bersaglieri squads and veteran HQ units modeled as Bersaglieri gain the Fire and Manoeuvre special rule. Rifle-armed models in a unit with Fire and Manoeuvre rule do not suffer the -1 shooting penality when advancing.

sharedRules.name: Non Testati
sharedRules.description: Before the enemy roll to hit or in close quartes, roll a D6: 1-2 Blackshirts becomes Shirkers. 3-4 the section remains the same. 5-6 Blackshirs gain the Fanatics special rule.Apply the ability before resolving the shooting or close combat. The result rolled then applies for the rest of the game.

sharedRules.name: Dubat Skirmishers
sharedRules.description: When outflanking, Dubats units may enter from either the left/right table edge as normal, or even from the enemy's own table edge.

sharedRules.name: Off-road Specialist
sharedRules.description: The AS42 was an exceptional all terrain vehicle that allowed its drivers to negotiate extremely difficult terrain. An AS42 may advance through rough ground at a rate of 9", with a single 90° turn.

sharedRules.name: Inexperienced Sabotateurs
sharedRules.description: Each enemy unit coming from reserve rolls a D6. If the results is 1,2 or 3 the enemy units coming in from reserve suffers an addittional -1 modifier on the order test to come on to the table. (if you have more than one of these rules in your list, this rule is not cumulative, and when all saboteur units are destroyed this special rule no longer applies).

sharedRules.name: Split Fire
sharedRules.description: The mortar in this group may fire at a different target from the rest of the squad.

sharedRules.name: Deflate those tyres!
sharedRules.description: All vehicles in this army may Advance through rough ground designated as sandy or rocky at a rate of 6", with a single 90-degree turn.

sharedRules.name: Additional armour
sharedRules.description: Treat as 7+ (armoured car) with the 'Open-topped' special trait, but loses the 'Deflate those tyres!' trait.

sharedRules.name: Team Medic
sharedRules.description: While the appointed team medic model is in the unit, he may use the medic special rule on any member of the team, including himself, and is not subject to the Geneva Convention rules.

sharedRules.name: Complex emplacement
sharedRules.description: The unit may not shoot if given an Advance order.

sharedRules.name: Surrender
sharedRules.description: Every time this squad is hit by enemy fire, the player controlling them must roll a D6. On a roll of 3-6, proceed to determine damage etc. On a roll of 1 or 2, the unit is detroyed and removed from the table. This represents them either surrendering or fleeing the battlefield. When assaulted, the opposing player moves they're assaaulting unit into base to base contact. The player controlling the squad then rolls a D6. Again, the squad is destroyed if the roll is a 1 or 2. This rule also applies to preparatory bombardments.

sharedRules.name: Avanti Avanti
sharedRules.description: Bersaglieri sections may re-roll failed order tests to Advance or Run

sharedRules.name: Voloire Battery
sharedRules.description: When given a Run Order, this unit may move up to 12" instead of 6"

sharedRules.name: Carica!
sharedRules.description: Instead of regrouping after any successful close-quarters combat, Savoia Cavalleria units can immediately be given a new assault order - roll for the order test as normal. this can be done once per game turn.

sharedRules.name: Exceptional Training
sharedRules.description: This unit always use their unmodified morale value for all morale based tests

sharedRules.name: Desertion
sharedRules.description: If a Squad with the Desertion special rule ends a turn having 3 or more casualities during that turn, roll adie. On a roll of 1 or 2 the squad deserts the battlefield. Remove the squad from the board; it counts as destroyed.

sharedRules.name: Avanti!, Prudente, Testardo
sharedRules.description:
•	Avanti!: Italian infantry units may reroll failed orders tests to Advance or Run if the Italian player is currently winning the game (use the victory points accrued by both sides already when a unit takes the orders test for the purposes of this rule).
•	Testardo: Italian infantry units have the stubborn special rule.
•	Prudente: Italian infantry units take an additional -1 penalty to all orders tests (not morale checks).

sharedRules.name: Forza D'animo
sharedRules.description: This unit removes D2 pins whenever it pass an order test.

sharedRules.name: Nessuna Resa
sharedRules.description: Granatieri units re-roll failed morale cheks if they lose more than half their number.

sharedRules.name: Spirito di Gruppo
sharedRules.description: The ‘’Defeat after Defeat, Followed by Impending Defeat” army special rule does not apply to a Granatieri di Sardegna platoon if a Granatieri Captain or Major are included (note they do not benefit from the ‘Avanti Savoia!’ special rule, either).

sharedRules.name: Bold Leadership
sharedRules.description: The ‘Poor Officers’ army special rule does not apply to Granatieri di Sardegna officers.

rules.name: Intelligence
rules.description: Once per game, at the beginning of any turn before the first die is drawn from the dice bag. Roll a D6 and apply modifiers: Inexperienced -1, Veteran +1. On a 4+, the player activating the Intelligence Officer may choose a die from the bag for the first activation. If both players attempt to activate this ability simultaneously, each must roll 1D6. The higher score wins and immediately uses this ability, but the losing player may attempt to use his ability on another turn instead.

rules.name: Inspiring Presence
rules.description: Upon receiving his order dice (except for Down), a chaplain may select one friendly unit within 6" and roll a D6, applying the following modifiers: Inexperienced -1, Veteran +1. On a 4+, the chaplain may remove 1 pin from the selected unit.

rules.name: Non Combatant
rules.description: The chaplain is there to support the soldiers, not win battles. A chaplain unit cannot be used to claim or contest objectives.

rules.name: Self-defence only
rules.description: Clergymen are not soldiers and will not take part in hostile actions - they cannot fire any weapon, nor assault enemy units. If your chaplain is equipped with a pistol, it can only be used in close quarters if the enemy assaults him (including firing it at the assaulting enemies as a reaction, if applicable).

rules.name: Gun assembly
rules.description: To simulate the fact that the gun was actually transported disassembled, when the gun is unlimbered the artillery unit suffers a pin. When the gun is limbered, the mule team (and consequently the transported artillery unit) suffers a pin.

rules.name: Stubborn (Mule)
rules.description: When taking an order test and doubles are rolled, the mules become stubborn and refuse to cooperate even if the order test was passed. Place the order dice to Down and add 1 pin marker to th eteam. This rule does not apply if Fubar is rolled.
